description: This file implements the advanced state-access functions for the Slap Obj Record Object within the Service Logic Aggregation Plane (SLAP) in a C source code file. It contains function declarations for getting and setting object entities, containers, and service components, as well as a reset function. The content includes licensing information, copyright notices, and documentation comments.

methods.name: SlapOroGetSlapObjEntity
methods.description: Retrieves the Slap Object Entity from the object.

methods.name: SlapOroSetSlapObjEntity
methods.description: Sets the Slap Object Entity in the object.

methods.name: SlapOroGetSlapObjContainer
methods.description: Retrieves the Slap Object Container from the object.

methods.name: SlapOroSetSlapObjContainer
methods.description: Sets the Slap Object Container in the object.

methods.name: SlapOroGetSlapSrvComponent
methods.description: Retrieves the Service Component associated with the object.

methods.name: SlapOroSetSlapSrvComponent
methods.description: Associates a Service Component with the object.

methods.name: SlapOroReset
methods.description: Resets the state of the object to its initial state.
